description: Response of POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/preview-links (Bitrise Remote Dev Environments API, HTTP 200). CreatePreviewLinkResponse carries the minted link.

jti.description: The link's id, also embedded in the token.

token.description: The signed link token ("<base64url payload>.<base64url signature>").

url.description: The shareable viewer URL — post this on the pull request or paste it into chat.
